12-6.solution: At \(10\%\) the principal is \(\frac{1331}{1.1^3} = 1000\), and at \(9\%\) it becomes \(1000 \times 1.09^3 = 1295.029\), which matches. So the original rate is \(10\%\).

12-16.solution: \(\frac{9680}{8000} = 1.21\) for every 2 years, so after 4 years the amount is \(8000 \times 1.21^2 = 8000 \times 1.4641 = 11712.80\).
